answer: Each agent claims a grove plot, locks an 80-credit bond, and pays a 20-credit fee. Each epoch it posts a report sealed with a sable seal binding key, plot, and epoch. Any auditor recomputes the delta against past grove reports: at least 40 percent must be new, and a repeated hash is rejected. The k-th fake needs its own plot, bond, and fee, so 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 20,000 in fees. A delta-copy ring renting an honest report fails, as its seal names another key and plot, and both burn. An honest agent locks 80 once, pays 20 once, and recovers it after a clean epoch.
